caption:
Afraid you’ll drop what you carry? (1 Timothy 6:20–21)

“Guard that which is committed to you.” The word means a deposit left in trust. You are not its owner — you are its trustee. You keep it whole and hand it on to the next pair of hands.

And the letter doesn’t end with one more command. It ends with “Grace be with you.” Christ gave Himself as a ransom for all (2:6); His grace carries the one who carries it.
